title: Shift compatibility of the reduction and total-limit adjunction
statement: Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$. For finite-type $k$-schemes $W$ with their small pro-etale sites put $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$, and let $\mathscr S_W$ be the abelian category of strict semilinear systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves, with its ordinary unbounded derived category, derived reduction $\mathcal R_W$ and total-limit functor $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]; regard $\mathscr S_W$ as the module category of the ring diagram $((A_n)_W)_n$ on the simultaneous ringed diagram site of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. Equip the reduction functor $\mathcal R_W$ and the total-limit functor $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ with the termwise cochain-shift comparisons, using the Roos total-cone model [def-weil-derived-limit] of $R\lim$ from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. The derived adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] has unit $u:P\to\mathcal L_W\mathcal R_WP$ and counit $e_N:\mathcal R_W\mathcal L_WN\to N$. For every integer $r$, both $u$ and $e$ commute with the shift comparisons, naturally in $P\in D(\widehat R_W)$ and $N\in D(\mathscr S_W)$, including the signs from the shifted Roos cone.
